title: SOFIE EU H2020 — table-grape transport and warehouse telemetry
policy_note: Food benchmark policy, not regulation or a product label. The -1 to 0 C band comes from the FAO table-grape post-harvest compendium. A 2 h allowance is ColdCall's explicit benchmark assumption: one sustained distribution-leg-scale interval out of band spends the budget. Retest at 50% and destroy at 100% are ColdCall policy thresholds. no_freeze_rule avoids treating every reading just below the optimum -1 C bound as proof of freezing; FAO reports the highest berry freezing point as -2.1 C and notes that it varies with soluble solids, while below-band time still consumes budget.
